stories.title: Jensen Huang Resigns From Nvidia After Affairs
stories.summary: Jensen Huang has resigned as CEO of Nvidia. This follows scrutiny over an alleged affair with a woman identified as a Chinese spy and another relationship with a subordinate at his company. Colette Kress, Nvidia's finance chief, has been appointed as the interim leader.

stories.title: Outlook, Teams and More Microsoft Programs Disrupted by Outage
stories.summary: Microsoft reported that its services were improving after a software outage affected millions of users. The disruption impacted access to email and other tools, including Outlook and Teams.

stories.title: Google launches Gemini 4 Hydrogen AI model for faster coding, search and everyday tasks
stories.summary: Google has introduced its Gemini 4 Hydrogen AI model. This new model is designed to enhance the speed of coding, search functions, and various daily tasks.

stories.title: 60% Indian organisations investing in AI report positive returns
stories.summary: A report indicates that 60% of Indian organizations investing in artificial intelligence are experiencing positive returns on their investments.

stories.title: Spotify launches audiobooks in India with 3.5 lakh English titles, 7,000 Indian-language books, starting
stories.summary: Spotify has introduced audiobooks in India, offering a selection of 350,000 English titles and 7,000 books in Indian languages.

stories.title: A Scorecard for Huang’s Exit From Nvidia
stories.summary: The departure of Jensen Huang from Nvidia, the chipmaker he co-founded, is having a significant impact across Silicon Valley, Washington, and other regions. This event is being closely watched for its implications in the technology sector.

stories.title: India Posts Highest-Ever Monthly Export Earnings As Exports Jump 29.9%
stories.summary: India achieved its highest-ever monthly export earnings in October 2026, reaching $89.99 billion. This represents a 29.9% increase compared to the previous year, driven by a rise in merchandise shipments and a reduced trade deficit.

stories.title: Paytm Gets RBI Nod To Restart Digital Wallet Business After 3-Year Break
stories.summary: Paytm has received approval from the Reserve Bank of India to resume its digital wallet operations after a three-year hiatus. This decision could allow Paytm to re-enter the digital wallet market, provided it meets the central bank's specified conditions.

stories.title: Looking Past Nvidia Turmoil, Stocks Log Best Week in Months
stories.summary: Despite a decline in Nvidia's stock following the removal of its CEO, the broader market has not been negatively affected. In fact, artificial intelligence stocks generally saw gains, contributing to the market's best week in several months.

stories.title: India's Forex Reserves Rise $2.49 Billion To $719.55 Billion As Gold Holdings Surge
stories.summary: India's foreign exchange reserves increased by $2.49 billion, reaching a total of $719.55 billion. This rise was primarily supported by a significant increase in the country's gold holdings, according to recent data from the Reserve Bank of India.

stories.title: Trump Admin Faces Growing Scrutiny After Nvidia CEO Resigns
stories.summary: The Trump administration is facing increased examination following the resignation of Nvidia's CEO.

stories.title: Chris Van Hollen Set to Challenge Chuck Schumer for Senate Majority Leader
stories.summary: Senator Chris Van Hollen is expected to challenge Senator Chuck Schumer for the position of Senate Majority Leader. Van Hollen is a preferred choice for some Democrats, despite Schumer's claim of having enough votes to secure the win.

stories.title: After Influence Peddling Claims, White House Restricts Lobbyist Meetings
stories.summary: The White House has implemented new restrictions on meetings with lobbyists after allegations of influence peddling. This policy, from the office of Chief of Staff Stephen Miller, aims to demonstrate the administration's independence from special interest groups.

stories.title: 'My Phone Is Tapped By PM Modi': Rahul Gandhi's Explosive Claim
stories.summary: Rahul Gandhi has made a significant claim that his phone is being tapped by Prime Minister Modi.

stories.title: 'Throwing Muck At The Dead': Abhijit Iyer-Mitra On Sonia Gandhi’s Memoir I 1984, Godhra, Emergency
stories.summary: Abhijit Iyer-Mitra commented on Sonia Gandhi's memoir, discussing topics such as 1984, Godhra, and the Emergency.

stories.title: DHS wants every H-1B extension reviewed from scratch; the rule is only proposed and comments close November 13
stories.summary: The Department of Homeland Security is proposing a new rule that would require all H-1B visa extensions to be reviewed as if they were new applications. This change could significantly impact foreign workers in the U.S., and public comments on the proposal are open until November 13.

stories.title: US, UK lose international students as visa curbs bite: Enrolments fall 19% in Britain and 13% in America; Asia gains
stories.summary: Both the United States and the United Kingdom are experiencing a decline in international student enrollments, with drops of 13% and 19% respectively. This trend is attributed to stricter visa policies in these countries, while Asian nations are seeing an increase in international student numbers.

stories.title: Canada Immigration Plan 2027–2029: Government caps new international student arrivals at 1.5 lakh annually
stories.summary: The Canadian government has announced its immigration plan for 2027–2029, which includes a new cap on international student arrivals. The country will now limit new international students to 150,000 per year.

stories.title: H-1B Wage Rule Moves to White House Review
stories.summary: A new rule concerning H-1B visa wages has advanced to the White House for review. This indicates a potential change in how wages for these specialized foreign workers are determined.

stories.title: USCIS Implements New Rule Affecting U.S. Work Visa Applications
stories.summary: U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services (USCIS) has put a new rule into effect that will impact applications for U.S. work visas. This change could affect individuals seeking to work in the United States.
